newsitem.title: USA: TEXAS/W OKLA FED CATTLE AT $64, UNCHANGED - USDA.
newsitem.headline: TEXAS/W OKLA FED CATTLE AT $64, UNCHANGED - USDA.

text.p: Trade moderate in the panhandle area Friday, USDA said.
Slaughter steers and heifers steady. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 3,900 slaughter steers and 1,900 heifers following the weekly movement of 88,400 head.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs
64.00. Pen Select and Choice 1-3 1250 lb Holstein cross 63.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1076-1125 lbs 64.00.
Confirmed - 5,800 Last Week - None Year Ago - None
